'''GEMINI Prime''' was an advanced [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed by the [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] that built the artificial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iokath]]. The Prime was used as the template for the construction of the [[GEMINI]] series of droids, which were in turn installed as the [[Captain/Legends|captains]] of the [[Eternal Fleet]]'s warships.<ref name="Chapter 14" /> Like the rest of Iokath's droids, the GEMINI units eventually turned on their masters and wiped them out, but were driven into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] with their [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] locked, where they drifted for thousands of years until they were discovered by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Chapter 4" /> GEMINI Prime was placed in a [[Darvannis factory|factory]] on the planet [[Darvannis]], where she was used to create more GEMINI units until the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] [[Raid on Darvannis|raided]] the facility and captured her. The Alliance hoped to use the Prime against the Fleet by installing her in one of the Eternal Fleet's ships, but their plan was derailed by [[SCORPIO]], another of Iokath's creations; SCORPIO deactivated the Prime and left her in a state of unresponsiveness.<ref name="Chapter 15">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=15}}</ref>
